target_definition: Visible noodles and surrounding edible contents only; exclude ceramic bowl, entire spoon including liquid it holds, chopsticks and background. Partial coverage must be disclosed; no requirement to remove every topping.
provenance: Assistant research annotations, not actual human approval. Initial mask 0 includes spoon; mask 1 has broad/speckled boundaries; mask 2 omits much food. One fixed correction adds explicit protected-object negatives and noodle positives. No mask pixels edited.
